name: PLS Faceplate
tagline: A better home screen for your Android car stereo.
overview: PLS Faceplate replaces the stock home screen on vertical Android car stereos with a light, fully adjustable Pulse home screen and its own OBD link. It's in development, so proofs will come from the app once it exists.

capabilities.title: Speed in mph
capabilities.text: GPS speed in mph (or km/h), from OBD when an adapter is connected.

capabilities.title: Move and size every panel
capabilities.text: Every panel moves and resizes with one control; the layout survives key-off.

capabilities.title: Nothing cut off
capabilities.text: Labels and status text sized for the screen, never clipped or stacked.

capabilities.title: OBD that talks to older GM trucks
capabilities.text: ELM327-type adapters over Bluetooth, J1850 VPW included; plain-words message when an adapter can't connect.

capabilities.title: Opens the stereo's own apps
capabilities.text: Radio, Bluetooth phone, 360 camera, CarPlay / Android Auto in one tap.

capabilities.title: Light on the stereo
capabilities.text: Small and quick; tested on our in-house bench.

capabilities.title: No strings
capabilities.text: No ads, no account, no tracking.

note: The app isn't built yet, so nothing is shown here. Proofs come from the app once it exists.
